aiOverview.content: Several major class action lawsuits against Google have reached settlements or are ongoing, focusing on data privacy, antitrust, and consumer protection. Notable 2026 cases include a $700M Play Store antitrust settlement, a $135M Android cellular data collection settlement, and a $68M voice assistant recording suit. Users should check specialized websites to file claims. Key Google Class Action Lawsuits and Settlements: Google Play Store Antitrust ($700 Million): A settlement was reached over claims that Google monopolized app distribution and in-app billing, causing higher prices for consumers. Android Data Collection ($135 Million): This lawsuit alleges Android devices sent data to Google over cellular networks even when idle, resulting in a $135 million settlement. The deadline to file a claim is May 9, 2026. Google Assistant Privacy ($68 Million): Google agreed to pay $68 million to settle claims that it illegally recorded private conversations via its voice assistant. Incognito Mode Privacy (Pending): A lawsuit alleging tracking in Chrome's "Incognito" mode was tentatively settled. Advertiser Monopoly ($100 Million): A potential settlement regarding overpayments in the AdWords program. How to Find and Join Lawsuits:Many class action settlements have dedicated websites. Examples include: Google Play State AG Antitrust Litigation Google Play State AG Antitrust Litigation Cellular Data Class Action Cellular Data Class Action Google Assistant Privacy Class Action Google Assistant Privacy Class Action Top Class Actions often lists available claims.
